AreaFrontend.title: A new brand is a configuration change
AreaFrontend.description: Pick a brand or move the hue: the components on the right only read semantic tokens, so they re-theme without touching their code. It is the same 3-layer model as the real white-label.

demo.note: Changing a real brand's primary color is a diff of about 11 lines in its config.

AreaBackend.title: One payment, even if you click twice
AreaBackend.description: Simulate a charge's lifecycle. Try «Double-click pay»: the second attempt finds the obligation's lock and returns the same payment with the same idempotency key. At the end, replay the webhook: the already-applied event is ignored.
